Round 1

Scanner scans now follow the time contract, preserve Entry or Exit direction, report rejected offline results separately and show both approved Entry refusal instructions.

The four functional members are Done. The combined browser and real Access journeys passed on the frozen candidate. All five diagnostics detected their intended defects and eight clean repetitions passed.

All four independent review areas reached HUMAN_REVIEW. This is technical readiness, not owner approval.

The full release diff includes prepared workflow maintenance as well as the four functional deliveries. TKT-563 adds report evidence only. Actual contributing models are gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, claude-opus-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5. Gemini 3.8 Flash high reviews every final area and differs from all authors. Copied Opus fixture contributions remain in that set. No code or fixes from the abandoned 24f1c209 implementation or PR 451 were reused.

S-2 stays active and TKT-563 stays open until the owner approves the exact candidate, committed report, brief and scope targets. Report publication still follows exact-head local, hosted and post-merge checks, with their final receipts on the board. No tag or deployment is planned. Venue qualification remains TKT-560.

Retrospective

Observed-data cutoff 2026-10-20T21:34:53.548800+00:00. The packet binds the operation-log snapshot and board metrics. Closure-task work after that cutoff, including final review, report publication, hosted CI, post-merge verification and approval waiting, is excluded from these cost observations.

Active implementation, pure model compute, exclusive CI wait and unexplained idle are n/a where no observation separates them. Status dwell is elapsed time. Reviews, gates and CI overlap and must not be added as exclusive work. Monetary spend is n/a. No routine work-unit checkpoints were added.

Functional local gates were TKT-559 3 runs with 1 failure, TKT-399 fresh implementation 8 with 3 failures, TKT-551 3 with 0 failures and TKT-552 2 with 0 failures. The closure candidate gate took 876.796 s. Closure clean probe repetitions took 212.033 s including stack work, and full browser verification took 171.618 s. One probe assertion repair required rerunning all five diagnostics and eight restored repetitions. Earlier failures remain in the evidence.

TKT-399 retained plan rounds 1 to 3 and code history through round 9. The owner authorized fresh code rounds 8 to 11; no cap was reset. TKT-551 used two plan rounds and one code round. TKT-552 used two plan rounds and one code round. TKT-559 used one of each. Below-threshold corrections and their verification remain disclosed in each closeout. No High or Critical finding was overridden.

Observed waits dominated some elapsed windows. TKT-399 records provider waits of 7 h 40 m 14 s and 4 h 56 m 56 s, and an owner-decision handoff of 5 h 45 m 39 s. TKT-551 records a 25360.476 s provider-stop-to-owner-resume interval. These are recorded windows, not proof of continuous unavailability or exclusive active work. TKT-552 had no provider or owner stop.

Observed review windows include dispatch and result handling. TKT-559 code initial and audit were about 228 s and 157 s. TKT-399 plan round 3 initial and audit were 563.264 s and 521.803 s, code round 9 was 156.402 s and 79.028 s, and Astra DNS implementation was 717.480 s. TKT-551 plan initial windows were 315.749 s in round 1 and 362.812 s in round 2; round 2 audit was 460.413 s. Its code initial was 218.295 s, failed quota audit 298.818 s and successful retry 282.343 s. TKT-552 code initial and audit were 187.172 s and 146.860 s. Other exclusive model times are n/a. These observations overlap other work.

Hosted functional check runtimes remain per-head observations. TKT-559 recorded 951 s. TKT-399 recorded 942, 1027, 994 and 1025 s on successive heads. TKT-551 retained 1020 s for its first head and 883 s for the final head. TKT-552 recorded 972 s. They overlap local work.

Fixture defects recur across timing tests, host-DNS fault injection, mixed-result assertions and the Entry-copy routed-fetch wrapper. Focused baseline runs, full gates, diagnostics and independent review exposed different gaps. The final review distinguishes those evidence defects from product design defects and from missing venue qualification.
